# Tracked JavaScript files (.js, .mjs, .cjs) the repository keeps. Code of
# the repository is Go or TypeScript; "go run ./cmd/repotool check-js" in
# betterdesk-server fails on any other JavaScript file.
#
# One path or glob per line, from the repository root; * matches within a
# folder, ** any number of folders. Each entry has a comment right above it
# that says why the file stays JavaScript, and an entry that matches no
# tracked file fails the check too.

# Runs inside the MeshCentral agent's own JavaScript engine, not in Node or
# a browser, so it has to be JavaScript.
betterdesk-server/meshcentral/assets/bettercore.js

# Built web app trees the embedding and file serving tests read: a build
# of the web app is JavaScript.
betterdesk-server/console/embedfs/testdata/**
betterdesk-server/console/webui/testdata/site/**
